column1: # Intercom: crew-only scenes with two or more lines. Always funny, never in a serious phase. New keys: ic_
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.

column13: Did you see that out the window?
Do you sleep well up here?
Do you feel us spinning too?

column12: Creo que alguien tocó algo otra vez.
column13: I think someone touched something again.

column12: ¿Cuántos cohetes se estrellaron antes de este?
column13: How many rockets crashed before this one?
Do you know how to fly this?

column12: Leí el manual. La primera página.
column13: I read the manual. The first page.

column12: El manual dice que no toquemos nada.
column13: The manual says not to touch anything.
When we get back, I want a pizza.

column12: ¿Por qué está tan callado el motor?
column13: Why is the engine so quiet?

column12: No mires el indicador de combustible.
column13: Don't look at the fuel gauge.
They floated into my mouth on their own.

column12: ¿Quién ha tocado el botón de etapas?

column13: I just wanted to see if it worked.

column12: Creo que me he dejado la luz encendida en casa.
column13: I think I left the light on at home.

column12: Pues la factura va a ser astronómica.
column13: Then the bill will be astronomical.

column12: ¿Sabes por qué la Mun no tiene amigos?
column13: Do you know why the Mun has no friends?

column12: Porque siempre nos da la espalda.
column13: Because it always turns its back on us.

column12: Porque siempre está pasando por una fase.
column13: Because it's always going through a phase.
If nobody watches us, are we still spinning?

column12: Eso es demasiado profundo para esta cápsula.
column13: That's too deep for this capsule.

column12: Tu traje huele a queso viejo.
column13: Your suit smells like old cheese.
Three, two, one, la la la!
Will you swap seats with me?

column12: Por eso lo pregunto con educación.
He contado los botones. Hay ciento doce.
column13: I counted the buttons. There are a hundred and twelve.
Yesterday there were a hundred and eleven.

column12: ¿Me das un poco de tu sándwich?
column13: Can I have some of your sandwich?

column12: ¿Qué le dijo un cohete a otro cohete?
column13: What did one rocket say to the other rocket?

column12: Nos vemos en la siguiente etapa.
column13: See you at the next stage.

column12: Has dejado la ventana llena de huellas.
column13: You left fingerprints all over the window.

column12: Mi madre cree que trabajo en una oficina.
column13: My mom thinks I work in an office.

column12: Técnicamente, esto es una oficina muy alta.
column13: Technically, this is a very high office.
Last night you snored like an engine.
One of my socks is missing.
Ah, that's why it smells like that.

column12: ¿Crees que hay vida en otros planetas?
column13: Do you think there's life on other planets?

column12: Pues yo me declaro una emergencia.
column13: Then I declare myself an emergency.

column12: El piloto dice que el manual es opcional.
column13: The pilot says the manual is optional.

column12: El piloto también dice que los frenos son opcionales.
column13: The pilot also says brakes are optional.

column12: Mi pelo flota como una medusa.
column13: My hair floats like a jellyfish.

column12: He traído una piedra de Kerbin como recuerdo.
column13: I brought a rock from Kerbin as a souvenir.

column12: Por si la echo de menos.
Ah, ahí está. Y mi bocadillo.
column13: Ah, there it is. And my sandwich.
Let me fly for a while.

column12: La última vez aterrizaste en un lago.
column13: Last time you landed in a lake.
I'm not whistling. It's the vents.

column12: La ventilación no sabe esa canción.
column13: The vents don't know that song.

column12: Le he puesto nombre a la nave.
column13: I gave the ship a name.

column12: Mi té está flotando en bolitas.
column13: My tea is floating in little balls.

column12: Era tu linterna en el cristal.
column13: It was your flashlight on the glass.

column12: Una luz rara, como te digo.
column13: A weird light, like I said.

column12: Te apuesto a que no tocas el techo.
column13: I bet you can't touch the ceiling.
